interface.name: org_kde_kwin_fake_input
interface.description: This interface allows a client to inject pointer and touch events into the compositor. It is meant for testing and accessibility tools.

request.name: authenticate
request.description: Ask the compositor to authenticate this client. A compositor may ignore every other request until it did.
